literal.prompt: С каким чувством прежде всего связан язык?

finalGroupBindings.primaryGround: The prompt/key pair is uniquely grounded: OpenStax calls gustation the special sense associated with the tongue (L63-L67). The alternatives name distinct senses: balance is encoded by inner-ear equilibrium structures (L134-L138), hearing by ear structures and auditory signaling (L101-L107), and vision by retinal photoreceptors (L43-L47, L59). Thus only taste has the stated tongue relation.

finalGroupBindings.literal: Язык связан с чувством вкуса: вкусовые почки в сосочках языка содержат рецепторные клетки. Он также участвует в речи, жевании и глотании.
finalGroupBindings.primaryGround: The revised explanation now directly names the keyed sense of taste: the tongue is associated with taste (OpenStax 14.1 L63-L67). It preserves the existing supported facts that taste buds in tongue papillae contain receptor cells (14.1 L64-L67) and that the tongue contributes to speech/vocalization, chewing and swallowing (OpenStax 23.3 L46-L52, L163-L168). Only the explicit tongue-to-sense-of-taste link was added.
finalGroupBindings.locator: OpenStax 14.1 L63-L67; OpenStax 23.3 L46-L52 and L163-L168

finalGroupBindings.literal: Внутреннее ухо кодирует положение и движение головы для чувства равновесия.
finalGroupBindings.primaryGround: OpenStax states that the inner ear encodes equilibrium and that vestibular hair cells sense head position and movement (L134-L138). The revised note states this concrete fact about the balance distractor.

finalGroupBindings.literal: Слух обеспечивают наружное, среднее и внутреннее ухо вместе со слуховыми путями.
finalGroupBindings.primaryGround: OpenStax describes the external ear, middle-ear ossicles, inner ear and auditory transduction into neural signals (L101-L107). This is a concrete fact about the hearing distractor.

OpenStax identifies retinal photoreceptors as specialized receptors responding to light (L43-L47) and states that vision involves activation of photoreceptors (L59). This is a concrete fact about the vision distractor.

finalGroupBindings.literal: Вкусовые почки в сосочках языка содержат рецепторные клетки.
finalGroupBindings.primaryGround: OpenStax describes taste buds within papillae and specialized gustatory receptor cells (14.1 L64-L67); the mouth/tongue chapter also states fungiform papillae contain taste buds (23.3 L51-L52). The wording distinguishes papillae from taste buds.
